question: What essential condition determines whether Vedic and other mantras attain efficacy?
premises: All Vedic and other mantras are considered.
They do not succeed without someone.
inference: All Vedic and other mantras fail to attain efficacy without that essential one.
uncertainties: The referent of yaṃ is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: All mantras, Vedic and others, do not succeed without him.
